title: Layout
description: full = title, artist, difficulty and mapper, the map's star rating with BPM and mods, plus the difficulty settings. compact = the same without the difficulty settings.

title: Orientation
description: auto = a strip when the page is at least 2.2× wider than tall (e.g. the taiko band above the lane), otherwise a column. Type scales to the page size either way.

title: Alignment
description: Which edge the content hugs (mirrors the layout). auto = right for osu! and catch (right column), left for taiko (band right of the mascot) and mania (left corner).

title: Original-language titles
description: Show the title and artist in their original script (titleUnicode / artistUnicode) when the map has them.

title: Difficulty settings
description: Full layout: a row with the mod-adjusted settings for the ruleset being played: osu! AR/CS/OD/HP, catch AR/CS/HP, taiko OD/HP, mania OD/HP. In the 216 px osu!/catch side column the row is always BPM, AR and OD (osu!) or BPM, AR and CS (catch), and the BPM moves there from beside the star rating. The row gives way to a title that needs two lines.

title: Progress and time
description: The map's progress as a hairline in the map colour (the same clock as strain-graph, which shows the time). Turn it off when strain-graph is on screen.

title: Motion
description: full = the card eases in and out of play, the identity fades on a map change, a BPM change settles in, and the progress hairline lifts and breathes during kiai. reduced = values and enter/exit still ease; no BPM nudge or kiai ambience. off = everything instant.

title: Backing
description: scrim = a dark field with soft edges that keeps small text readable on bright maps. panel = a solid graphite panel. none = text straight on the game with a contrast shadow; only for a dimmed background.

title: Corner marks
description: The 18-LAB registration marks on the box's top-left and bottom-right corners. neutral = warm white. amber = both in 18-LAB amber. tl = amber, top-left only. none = no marks.

title: Map colour
description: Colour the map's identity (progress and star) from the map's background. Off = neutral. Your own highlights stay 18-LAB amber either way.
